name: Module 3 - Compile RPGLE stream file
command: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) TGTRLS(*CURRENT) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

name: Module 3 - Compile SQLRPGLE no-commit lab
command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') COMMIT(*NONE) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) TGTRLS(*CURRENT)

name: Module 3 - Compile SQLRPGLE commitment-control lab
command: ?CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') COMMIT(*CHG) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) TGTRLS(*CURRENT)
